Title: Prespecified analysis plan and dated amendments
Legend: The analysis plan was fixed on 25 September 2026 before any CADD v1.7 or AVI calibration result and tagged in the version-controlled repository (analysis-plan-v1). Each later analysis was specified in a dated amendment committed before it was run. The Timing column states whether the amendment was motivated by results already seen, and the last column whether the analysis is reported in this article. Post hoc analyses that were not specified in any amendment are listed at the end.

Title: Predictors, score precision and window increments
Legend: Score sources and versions, the precision at which scores were used and the window increment of the local posterior method, chosen to match the original study.

Title: Published versus reproduced CADD v1.6 thresholds
Legend: Thresholds of Pejaver et al. (2022, Table 2) and those obtained with our R implementation on the authors' deposited data (10,000 bootstrap replicates, seed 20260925).

Title: Seed sensitivity of the CADD v1.6 reproduction
Legend: Thresholds for five random seeds (10,000 replicates each) with the fraction of bootstrap replicates that did not reach each level.

Title: Sensitivity analyses of the CADD v1.7 and AVI calibration
Legend: Thresholds (seed 20260925) in the main analysis and in the four prespecified sensitivity analyses, namely review status of at least two stars (two_stars), rarity defined as AF below 0.001 (AF_below_0.001), gene-level bootstrap (gene_bootstrap) and exclusion of missense SNVs within 3 nucleotides of an internal exon boundary (no_exon_edge_3nt). Empty cells indicate levels not reached.

Title: Temporal hold-out validation
Legend: Positive likelihood ratios of each evidence interval of CADD v1.7 and AVI calibrated on the ClinVar release of 27 January 2024 and evaluated on 58,920 variants (22,626 P/LP, 36,294 B/LB) first classified afterwards, with 95% bootstrap intervals (1,000 replicates), the required ratio and whether it was met at the point estimate and at the conservative 95% bound. The second block compares 2024 and 2026 thresholds.

Title: Calibration and discrimination of five predictors on the intersection set
Legend: Thresholds (median [range] over five seeds) and AUROC and AUPRC with 95% bootstrap intervals and paired differences versus AVI (1,000 replicates), on the 59034 P/LP and 75306 B/LB ClinVar variants (4725 genes) and 1888558 gnomAD variants scored by all five predictors.

Title: MaveDB score sets used for validation
Legend: The 89 MaveDB score sets with normal and abnormal functional classes, with gene, calibration used, mapping level, numbers of scored and classified variants, protein reference-residue match rate, licence and primary publication (PubMed ID); the second block gives classified MANE missense SNVs per gene after excluding discordant classifications. Please cite MaveDB and the primary publication of each score set.

Title: Calibrated evidence intervals on MAVE functional classes
Legend: For each predictor and ClinVar-calibrated evidence interval, the likelihood ratio P(interval | functionally abnormal) / P(interval | functionally normal) with 95% bootstrap interval (2,000 replicates) and abnormal/normal variants in the interval, and the pooled AUROC, on 93,154 MANE missense SNVs in 39 genes (18,936 abnormal, 74,218 normal) from 89 MaveDB score sets. Functional abnormality is not pathogenicity; the ratios test direction and ordering, not the ClinGen targets.

Title: Calibrated evidence for ClinVar VUS of January 2024 that were resolved by September 2026
Legend: Amendment A15. VUS (>= 1 star, MANE Select missense, disease gene) in the ClinVar release of 27 January 2024, followed to the release of 23 September 2026. Thresholds: r2024 = calibrated on the January 2024 release only (five-predictor intersection, primary); main2026 and inter2026 = 2026 thresholds (secondary). Blocks: set sizes; percentage of variants with PP3 or BP4 evidence and mean ACMG/AMP points by 2026 outcome; concordance of the evidence with the 2026 classification; likelihood ratio of each interval, P(interval | resolved P/LP) / P(interval | resolved B/LB), with 95% bootstrap interval (2,000 replicates), the ratio required and whether the conservative bound meets it. Subset AF<0.01 (gnomAD v4.1 group maximum) is primary.

Title: Calibrated computational evidence for ClinVar missense VUS of January 2024 that were resolved by September 2026
Legend: Each interval cell gives the likelihood ratio P(interval | later classified P/LP) / P(interval | later classified B/LB) [95% bootstrap interval, 2,000 replicates] and, in parentheses, variants later classified P/LP / B/LB in the interval. Variants were VUS with at least one star, MANE Select missense in disease genes, and gnomAD v4.1 allele frequency below 0.01 in the ClinVar release of January 27, 2024 (1,790 later classified P/LP and 3,989 B/LB in the release of September 23, 2026). Evidence intervals use thresholds calibrated only to the January 2024 release for the five predictors across the variants scored by all of them. Mean points follow the ACMG/AMP point system (±1 supporting, ±2 moderate, ±4 strong) [5]. —, level not reached. *The conservative bound of the 95% interval does not meet the likelihood ratio that the strength requires (5.79 for PP3 moderate, 33.53 for PP3 strong, 1/33.53 for BP4 strong). Results with 2026 thresholds and for all variants are given in Table S10.

Title: Illustrative resolved VUS
Legend: Variants selected by the rule fixed in amendment A15 before inspection: VUS in January 2024 whose September 2026 record was reviewed by an expert panel or practice guideline, up to three per direction with the largest absolute AVI points (r2024 thresholds), ties broken by genomic position. Scores and evidence levels of all five predictors with the r2024 thresholds.

Title: Computational evidence for ClinVar missense variants of uncertain significance
Legend: Number and percentage of 1,208,461 ClinVar missense VUS (at least one star, MANE Select, disease genes) at each evidence level for each predictor, with ACMG/AMP points, using main-analysis thresholds (CADD, AVI) or intersection thresholds (all five), for all VUS and for VUS with AF below 0.01; the second block cross-tabulates CADD and AVI levels.

Title: Concordant calibrated evidence and transferred thresholds for all ClinVar missense VUS
Legend: Amendment A16. The 1,208,430 rare (gnomAD v4.1 AF max < 0.01) MANE Select missense VUS with at least one star in disease genes, ClinVar release of 23 September 2026. Blocks: thresholds used (CADD and AVI, Table 1; REVEL, BayesDel and AlphaMissense, published ClinGen values; CADD16, published CADD v1.6 values applied to CADD v1.7 scores); number of VUS by concordant ACMG/AMP points, for all VUS and for those reviewed by an expert panel or practice guideline (3-4 stars), and number whose evidence level or direction differs between transferred CADD v1.6 thresholds and calibrated CADD v1.7 or AVI thresholds; cross-tabulations of evidence levels under transferred CADD v1.6 thresholds against calibrated CADD v1.7 and against calibrated AVI.

Title: ClinVar missense VUS reviewed by expert panels with concordant calibrated computational evidence, by gene
Legend: The 23 genes with at least ten such variants (856 of 1,094) are shown. Expert-panel VUS, rare (gnomAD v4.1 allele frequency below 0.01) MANE Select missense VUS in the ClinVar release of September 23, 2026, reviewed by an expert panel or practice guideline. Concordant, VUS for which REVEL, BayesDel, and AlphaMissense (published ClinGen thresholds [6,8]) and AVI (Table 1) all gave evidence in the same direction; the level is the weakest among the three missense predictors. Under the ACMG/AMP point system [5], PP3 strong (+4 points) completes a likely pathogenic classification (≥6 points) when the remaining evidence adds two points, PP3 moderate when it adds four, and BP4 moderate (−2 points) a likely benign classification (≤−1 point) unless the remaining evidence adds two or more points. Expert panels may already have applied gene-specific computational criteria, so these are candidates for reassessment rather than reclassification. Examples are the first three PP3 strong variants by genomic position (protein change in the MANE Select transcript). All 1,094 variants, with scores and evidence from each predictor, are listed in Table S16.

Title: ClinVar missense VUS reviewed by an expert panel with concordant calibrated computational evidence
Legend: Amendment A16. VUS in the ClinVar release of 23 September 2026 (MANE Select missense, disease gene) whose record was reviewed by an expert panel or practice guideline and for which REVEL, BayesDel and AlphaMissense (published ClinGen thresholds) and AVI (Table 1) all gave evidence in the same direction. Comp points, the smallest absolute ACMG/AMP points among the three missense predictors. Scenario, the other evidence with which these points would complete a likely pathogenic (>= +6 points) or likely benign (<= -1 point) classification under the ACMG/AMP point system; it is not a reclassification, because ClinVar does not record the points of the remaining evidence and expert panels may already have applied their own computational criteria. Ev CADD16, CADD v1.7 scores read with the published CADD v1.6 thresholds; Flip AVI, evidence in opposite directions under those thresholds and under calibrated AVI. AF max, gnomAD v4.1 group maximum allele frequency. Ordered by absolute points and genomic position. The 483,690 VUS with concordant evidence at any review status are in the repository (calibration/results/v17_avi/vus_candidates/vus_concordant_evidence.tsv.gz).

Title: Calibration of CADD v1.7 and AVI in the intronic splice region
Legend: Thresholds (one seed, 10,000 bootstrap replicates, missense prior 0.0441) for SNVs 3 to 8 nucleotides into introns of MANE Select transcripts, from 2,392 P/LP and 68,917 B/LB ClinVar variants and 175,221 rare gnomAD variants at the same positions and genes, compared with the missense thresholds.

Title: Missense-calibrated thresholds in noncoding and synonymous variant classes, and MPRA
Legend: Reference variants per region class; AUROC of CADD and AVI per class; likelihood ratios (with 1,000-replicate bootstrap intervals) of each missense-calibrated evidence interval in each class and whether the conservative bound meets the required ratio; AUROC for functional versus non-functional SNVs in saturation-mutagenesis MPRA data (Kircher et al. 2019).

Title: CADD v1.6 versus v1.7 on identical reference data
Legend: Thresholds (median and range over five seeds) of CADD v1.6 and v1.7 calibrated on the same 2026 reference sets, AUROC with 95% bootstrap intervals and the paired difference, the percentage of reference variants whose evidence level changes between versions, and the full cross-tabulation of evidence levels (each version at its own thresholds).

Title: Thresholds with and without HGMD Public positions
Legend: Thresholds of five predictors calibrated on the ClinVar 2019-12-02 and 2026-09-23 intersection sets with all variants (all) and after excluding SNVs at positions of single-nucleotide HGMD Public 2020.4 records (noHGMD), with the published values where available. Set sizes after exclusion were r2019_noHGMD 5395 P/LP, 9681 B/LB, 1665924 gnomAD; r2026_noHGMD 26254 P/LP, 72077 B/LB, 1872367 gnomAD.

Title: Thresholds across ClinVar releases and before or after November 2022
Legend: Thresholds (seed 20260925) of five predictors calibrated on the intersection sets of ClinVar releases 2019-12-02, 2022-11-19, 2024-01-27 and 2026-09-23, and on 2026 variants already present in November 2022 (pre2022) or added later (post2022). The common-scale block expresses each threshold as the percentage of 2026 gnomAD intersection variants meeting it (post hoc). Set sizes (P/LP, B/LB) were r2019 17330 / 11379; r2022 32868 / 32044; r2024 40282 / 49090; r2026 59034 / 75306; post2022 30007 / 51383; pre2022 29027 / 23923.

Title: Calibration by gene class
Legend: Class sizes, thresholds with 2.5th-97.5th percentile bootstrap intervals, pairwise comparisons (classes considered different when intervals do not overlap) and the percentage of reference variants whose evidence level changes with class-specific instead of global thresholds.
